blocks.text: READ: Follow Inquirer Sports’ special coverage of the Aichi-Nagoya Asian Games 2026 MANILA, Philippines–Charlotte Sales hit a go-ahead, three-run home run in the sixth inning as the Philippine Blu Girls rallied to beat South Korea, 7-3, on Monday for their first win in women’s softball of the Aichi-Nagoya Asian Games. Sales drilled one off pitcher Yeon Ji Choe past the left field fence with two outs that gave the Blu Girls a 5-3 lead after falling behind at Anjo Softball Ground.
